_comment: Merchant state for the affiliate links. gen/affiliate.mjs reads this;
ops/affiliate-switch.mjs writes it. Kept out of the code deliberately:
turning a merchant on or off is an operational decision made on revenue
data, not a code change, and this is the file an admin panel would write
awinmid     advertiser id from the Awin programme page (in its profile URL).
cookieDays  decides placement, not documentation. 30d survives the
pre-launch research window; 1d (Amazon) must sit at immediate
sells       which product kinds may route here; enforced at generation.
